The '''Dionaryll Tree''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The [[Ardan resistance]] used the canopy of one such [[Tree/Legends|tree]] to survey the area around [[Resolute Base]].<ref name="Arda I" />
